AssistantText.description:
A sentence or clause ready for display and TTS. ``spoken_form`` has dates, times, money
and phone numbers normalized for speech; ``text`` keeps canonical values.
AssistantText.title: AssistantText

Booking.description: A committed simulated reservation. Exists only after the database transaction commits.
Booking.title: Booking

CandidateRecord.description:
Server-held candidate facts. The language is a session preference (``SessionState``),
not a collected fact.
CandidateRecord.title: CandidateRecord

Confirmation.description: One read-back and its answer. A bare "yes" only means something against the pending one.
Confirmation.title: Confirmation

Evidence.description: Where a value came from: finalized user text of one turn, never an STT interim.
Evidence.title: Evidence

ReviewInParts.description: Being gone over in short parts; ``part`` is the one said last (0-based).
ReviewInParts.title: ReviewInParts

ReviewOffered.description: The read-back was cut and Ana offered to go over it; the candidate has not chosen yet.
ReviewOffered.title: ReviewOffered

ReviewWaived.description: The candidate chose to carry on without going over it: an informed skip.
ReviewWaived.title: ReviewWaived

RuntimeInfo.description:
What the page needs before it renders: which voice to offer and the stores; and the
commit this process runs, which the deploy waits for.
RuntimeInfo.title: RuntimeInfo

SessionEvent.description: SSE envelope. ``seq`` is monotonic per session and doubles as the SSE id.
SessionEvent.title: SessionEvent

SessionSnapshotResponse.description:
What `GET /api/sessions/{id}` returns: one consistent read for the owner. The pending
confirmation is ``state.pending_confirmation``; ``last_seq`` is where the stream resumes.
SessionSnapshotResponse.title: SessionSnapshotResponse

SessionState.description: The authoritative state the runtime reads and the repositories persist.
SessionState.title: SessionState

Signal.description: Conversational signal attached to the turn it came from; never a hiring input.
Signal.title: Signal

SignalProbabilities.description:
What a decision model gave each option (D52), shown on the page as it arrives (D62).
Advisory: the verdict in ``Signal`` is what the runtime acts on.
SignalProbabilities.title: SignalProbabilities

SignalRecorded.description:
The asynchronous classifier's verdict on one user turn, journaled after that turn
ended. Advisory: the reviewer panel and the export show it; it never scores anyone.
SignalRecorded.title: SignalRecorded

SlotOffer.description:
The slots Ana last offered, in the order she said them, and the ones an ambiguous answer
left in question (D41). The runtime matches the candidate's choice against it.
SlotOffer.title: SlotOffer

SourcesShown.description: What the candidate asked and which chunks were shown for it, title › section.
SourcesShown.title: SourcesShown

StateUpdated.description: Emitted after the transaction commits. The browser renders this, not the transcript.
StateUpdated.title: StateUpdated

TurnAccepted.description: The turn is queued; its events arrive on the session stream.
TurnAccepted.title: TurnAccepted

TurnFailed.description: Terminal for the turn; the session may continue. ``message`` is fixed public text.
TurnFailed.title: TurnFailed

TurnStarted.description:
Opens a turn. ``text`` is the finalized user input the turn answers (persisted before
this is emitted), empty for Ana's opening; the browser renders the user bubble from it so
the transcript comes from the stream alone, replay included.
TurnStarted.title: TurnStarted

Unknown.description: Two failed clarification attempts, or the candidate does not know.
Unknown.title: Unknown

VersionStamp.description: Attached to every session and evaluation run.
VersionStamp.title: VersionStamp
